authority: Subordinate to _question_structure/QUESTION_STRUCTURE_CORE.md; this bank specializes the universal structure rules for the District Math Worksheet Builder.
source_use_rule: Use source materials only to infer skill scope, structure, representation, pacing, and difficulty. Do not reproduce source wording, names, numbers, answer choices, or diagrams.

parallel_form_policy.invariant: Same I Can / learning target, evidence job, question-family architecture, response mode, and intended representation role.
parallel_form_policy.supported_version_count: 1-4 in the current worksheet UI; generator-family design is not intrinsically limited to four.

generator_rules.family_first: Choose a family from the resolved course/topic before writing prose.
generator_rules.parameterize: Instantiate original values/contexts under family constraints; never retrieve or lightly rewrite a source item.
generator_rules.parallel_forms: For A/B/C/D forms, preserve family/evidence/difficulty distribution slot-for-slot unless the teacher explicitly requests reordering. Vary parameters and surface contexts without changing the I Can.
generator_rules.visuals: Quantitative visuals must be deterministic and mathematically accurate. Use the registered Cartesian graph tool for supported coordinate graphs.
generator_rules.qa: Solve every instantiated item independently and verify answer/visual alignment.
